description:
Pingguo Xiang, 'apple aroma', is a Phoenix Mountain dancong name that shows up in a Chinese list of lines known for flavour, beside Rou Gui Xiang, Yang Mei Xiang and Xiang Fan Shu.

It sits outside the ten standard aroma types, and there is no published description of the tree, its village or its leaf. It may be a specific line or a looser trade description; little is documented either way.

As for making and brewing, all that can be said is what is typical of dancong: long shaking and resting, then hot water and quick pours.

When you see this name for sale, ask the seller whether it refers to a named tree or just describes the taste.
history: Little is documented: the name appears in a modern overview of dancong classification, with no date, place or person attached.
